Synopsis Against the Gods (Ni Tian Xie Shen) 3D

In the mystical Cangyun Continent, the Medicine Sage Yun Gu met a brutal end due to his possession of one of the Seven Heavenly Treasures, the coveted Sky Poison Pearl. This pearl became the desire of all realms, leading to Yun Che, his disciple, seeking vengeance for his master’s death, resulting in a trail of bloodshed. Ultimately, Yun Che found himself cornered at the treacherous Desolate Sky Cliff. In an act of desperation, he consumed the poison pearl and plunged to his apparent demise.

 

Yet, guided by an unknown force, his consciousness traversed the boundaries of time and space, awakening within the body of a young boy named Xiao Che in the Flowing Cloud City of the Tianxuan Continent. Born with damaged profound veins, Xiao Che was mocked as a profound energy waste within the city. Unexpectedly, he found himself married to Xia Qingyue, the city’s most beautiful woman and a disciple of the esteemed Ice Wind Immortal Palace, due to a pact between their parents.

 

Jealousy festered within Xiao Yulong, a fellow clan member, leading to an attempt to poison Xiao Che on his wedding day. However, thanks to Yun Che’s extraordinary time-traveling experience, Xiao Che not only survived but also merged the knowledge of two lifetimes into one. As fate would have it, he also harbored the soul of the enigmatic and extraordinarily gifted girl, Jasmine, residing within the Sky Poison Pearl. From that moment, Xiao Che embarked on an unpredictable and captivating journey, filled with extraordinary challenges.
